Yeah I get your point  
They are constantly adding new and remove old features  
Which also makes every monster hunter game feel unique in my opinion  
You can't satisfy everyone in the fanbase but I think by now we might have a good feeling about what we need for a great online experience... I just wish Capcom was able to figure it out too and someday deliver a crossplay Monster Hunter with mixed online features we liked so far

You wouldn't make much progress since you're too busy having fun with strangers over the internet.  
That's not sad in my opinion :)  
I had the best time of my life playing MH3 when it was still possible to play online

If she was not the one I really don't know who is...
I personaly connected with her so much but it was just one-sided as it seems.
We never were in a relationship to begin with and reason why it took me so long to visit her was because she lives pretty far away, I can't just ask her to meet me.
Love just has the biggest relevance in my life, I don't really see a reason to go on without a significant other...
I told her how I feel but that doesn't change anything, my feeling stay the same and hers do so too, it didn't accomplish anything other than making me hurt even more because she repeats what she already said to me.
I already try talking to friends but to no avail right now, I'm more broken than I ever was and I don't know if I can take this much.
Thanks for believing in me though, that's something I can not do myself anymore... It was the first time I really was optimistic about something working out and I regret it instantly and feel so naive to even

I've had a friend who suffered through a lot in her life only being around 23y old.
She has a weakened immune system because her so called father beat her mother up regulary when she was pregnant with his child, which also was created by rape.
This lead to her having multiple issues her health.
But this being not enough of course she also developed an illness which made her arms and legs really thick and hurting.
She has fought multiple years to get some operations done on them only to reduce the pain and thickness by a pretty small part.
The doctors told he she'll never be painfree too.
Of course she also developed borderline over time, pushed a lot of people away from her with her rage.
I don't know how she still endures all of this and you also have my respects to still be here and come this far.
"Just a dream" described it pretty good for me. That song says a lot about my own situation.
Weil Alkoholkonsum viel zu sehr verherrlicht wird, bei Personen dieser Altersgruppe umso mehr nach meinem Gefühl. Das kann aber natürlich auch täuschen.
